Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment involves IP-MS of FLAG-tagged CCNE1 using TMT labeling and DDA acquisition on an Orbitrap Fusion. While the study focuses on ABPP and covalent probes (tryptoline acrylamides), the specific IP-MS workflow described for the proteomics data uses TMT and DDA. No specific PTM enrichment (like phospho or diGly) was used for the IP-MS part; it was a protein-protein interaction study via IP.

scope: C-terminally 3xFLAG epitope-tagged CCNE1 WT or N112C mutant were transiently co-expressed with untagged CDK2 in HEK293T cells.
2 mg proteome per sample was used to incubate with 40 μL anti-DYKDDDDK Magnetic Agarose bead slurry (washed twice with lysis buffer) for 3 h at 4 °C.

The samples were eluted from beads using 50 μL 8 M urea in DPBS and 10-min 65 °C incubation, then reduced with 200 mM DTT at 65 °C for 15 min and alkylated with 400 mM iodoacetamide at 37 °C for 30 min.
samples were digested using MS-grade trypsin (Promega) at 37 °C overnight, followed by TMT labeling (Thermo Scientific) and desalting using Peptide Desalting Spin Columns (Pierce)
The labeled peptides were analyzed in Orbitrap Fusion Mass Spectrometer (ThermoFisher).

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry analysis (IP-MS) specifically targeted the CCNE1:CDK2 complex using anti-FLAG affinity capture from HEK293T cell lysates, rather than analyzing the whole cell lysate.
